jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: The Lord; calm authority, tender with the afflicted, grave in discourse.

the-jews.name: The Jews
the-jews.note: The Judean authorities and their party; hostile, pressing, sometimes merely onlookers.

other-jews.name: Others of the Jews
other-jews.note: A second party among the Jews answering or doubting the first.

crowd.name: Crowd
crowd.note: The multitude of pilgrims and hearers; acclaiming, wondering, questioning.

1.t: Amen, amen, I say to you: He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold but climbeth up another way, the same is a thief and a robber.

2.t: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

3.t: To him the porter openeth: and the sheep hear his voice. And he calleth his own sheep by name and leadeth them out.

4.t: And when he hath let out his own sheep, he goeth before them: and the sheep follow him, because they know his voice.

5.t: But a stranger they follow not, but fly from him, because they know not the voice of strangers.

6.t: This proverb Jesus spoke to them. But they understood not what he spoke.

7.t: Jesus therefore said to them again:
Amen, amen, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

8.t: All others, as many as have come, are thieves and robbers: and the sheep heard them not.

9.t: I am the door. By me, if any man enter in, he shall be saved: and he shall go in and go out, and shall find pastures.

10.t: The thief cometh not, but for to steal and to kill and to destroy. I am come that they may have life and may have it more abundantly.

11.t: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd giveth his life for his sheep.

12.t: But the hireling and he that is not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming and leaveth the sheep and flieth: and the wolf casteth and scattereth the sheep,

13.t: And the hireling flieth, because he is a hireling: and he hath no care for the sheep.

14.t: I am the good shepherd: and I know mine, and mine know me.

15.t: As the Father knoweth me, and I know the Father: and I lay down my life for my sheep.

16.t: And other sheep I have that are not of this fold: them also I must bring. And they shall hear my voice: And there shall be one fold and one shepherd.

17.t: Therefore doth the Father love me: because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

18.t: No man taketh it away from me: but I lay it down of myself. And I have power to lay it down: and I have power to take it up again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

19.t: A dissension rose again among the Jews for these words.

20.t: He hath a devil and is mad. Why hear you him?

21.t: These are not the words of one that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
21.q: the party among the Jews that answers the accusers of v20; second group voice

22.t: And it was the feast of the dedication at Jerusalem: and it was winter.

23.t: And Jesus walked in the temple, in Solomon's porch.

24.t: The Jews therefore came round about him and said to him:
How long dost thou hold our souls in suspense? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

25.t: I speak to you, and you believe not: the works that I do in the name of my Father, they give testimony of me.

26.t: But you do not believe, because you are not of my sheep.

27.t: My sheep hear my voice. And I know them: and they follow me.

28.t: And I give them life everlasting: and they shall not perish for ever. And no man shall pluck them out of my hand.

29.t: That which my Father hath given me is greater than all: and no one can snatch them out of the hand of my Father.

30.t: I and the Father are one.

31.t: The Jews then took up stones to stone him.

32.t: Many good works I have shewed you from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?

33.t: For a good work we stone thee not, but for blasphemy: and because that thou. being a, man, makest thyself God.

34.t: Is it not written in your law: I said, you are gods?

35.t: If he called them gods to whom the word of God was spoken; and the scripture cannot be broken:

36.t: Do you say of him whom the Father hath sanctified and sent into the world: Thou blasphemest; because I said: I am the Son of God?

37.t: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

38.t: But if I do, though you will not believe me, believe the works: that you may know and believe that the Father is in me and I in the Father.

39.t: They sought therefore to take him: and he escaped out of their hands.

40.t: And he went again beyond the Jordan, into that place where John was baptizing first. And there he abode.

41.t: And many resorted to him: and they said:

42.t: But all things whatsoever John said of this man were true.
42.q: taken as the continuation of the people's saying from v41, not narration
